notes.title: The Star Legation OST update!
notes.content:
Imagine my horror when a purchaser of The Star Legation OST notified me today that, though he was able to download the zip file from Steam, the music files were not in the file! I immediately tried to figure out what went wrong...

Though I had properly uploaded the zip file to the site, AND Steam had reviewed and approved it (even after telling me I had a redundancy in the file, which I corrected and re-uploaded...waiting 3 more days for another approval), it seems that the file did not get seated properly in the correct depot. I have fixed this issue and the purchaser was able to download it again and found all the files inside the zip file as he should have.

I'm so sorry that this has happened and I apologize to those of you that purchased the OST and wondered what happened to the music. It's ready and waiting for you to download again!

I hope you enjoy my music, and thanks for your support (and patience!)
Best,
Andy

notes.title: Patch 2/16/22
notes.content:
For non-native English speakers and others that would prefer it, text has been added for all of the ending epilogue scenes, and can be read by using the Backlog function (scroll up on mouse or type B). Voice acting will continue uninterrupted during this time. You can quickly flip back to the ending CG by clicking the right mouse button, or clicking the "Back" button on the Backlog screen. Once the voice acting dialogue has completed, click "End Game" to proceed.

Other small corrections have been made as well, including reducing the volume of the music slightly during the ending voice acting.

notes.title: The Star Legation game and OST have released!
notes.content:
[h2]After 3 years in solo-development, The Star Legation has finally launched! [/h2]

Customize the skills of the protagonist, Trey Donovan, and journey through space with a bizarre alien crew. Visit strange new worlds, negotiate with powerful alien leaders, and survive the deadly challenges of space, battle, and even your own crew! Risk romance across the stars and navigate every relationship with decisions that progressively affect your reputation with each character. Your choices really matter as your fate and the fate of your crew depend upon the reputations you've built and the difficult decisions you'll make. Are you ready for a meaningful and unforgettable space adventure?

[h2]Enjoy the music of The Star Legation with the 40-track, 99 minute OST![/h2]

The Original Soundtrack for The Star Legation includes musical pieces by professional musician and composer, Andy Mitchell. Described as a combination of techno and classical, each track was specifically designed to convey the mood and theme of a scene, with a wide variety of musical techniques and cultural elements used to reflect each alien cultural. The OST includes 40 tracks and 99 minutes of music, in addition to 9 pages of detailed composer notes about each title.

notes.title: Windows Release confirmed for Feb. 4. Mac version pending...
notes.content:
[h1]The Good News:[/h1]

[b]The Windows build of The Star Legation has been reviewed and approved by Steam, and will launch on schedule for 2/4/22.[/b]

[h1]The Bad News:[/h1]

[b]I have decided to remove the option for the Mac build temporarily from the store[/b], because I am uncertain whether a working build will be ready in time. Here is an update on the Mac version, and why there are delays for it:

1. As mentioned before, the game engine I used to build The Star Legation was updated and it currently does not support export to Macs as it used to (in the earlier version, I was able to create a demo for the Mac without problems.) However, I cannot roll back to the earlier version of the game engine because that version no longer exports games the size of The Star Legation, and it would also require a degree of re-coding many elements of the game.

2. I have several people experimenting with a work-around to the export problem, using a Japanese version of the program. Using this method, an export was successful, but it behaved differently than expected and some re-coding was done to make the beginning of the game play out properly. I am currently unsure of how the rest of the game runs, and cannot test it myself because a Mac is necessary. One of my beta testers is attempting to run this new version on his Mac, but the process of ensuring quality across the entire build is slow. 

Unless I can confirm that the Mac export functions properly without bugs, the Mac version will be delayed indefinitely. If such confirmation can be reached, however, I will add a Mac version to the store as soon as possible and will announce its availability here. Keep in mind, I am a first-time programmer and am still learning. Most of this is over my head. I apologize for the confusion and the wait.

Best,
Andy
Corefun Studios, LLC
